body.message:
Hello Hannah,

We have checked with the management regarding your request. Unfortunately, we are unable to reduce the quoted rate of AED 4,500.

Please note that the AED 4,500 rate was only applicable for the months of June and July. The rate shared for September is the updated rate based on the current availability and market conditions, and we are unable to offer any further reduction.

Please let us know if you would like to proceed with the booking, and we will be happy to assist you further.

Thank you.
